# Cornelia Bryant

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty years old in Volume 2; around middle-age  <sub>[v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c3 P0](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0000), [v2 c6 P44](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c3 P0](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Married (formerly single)  <sub>[v4 c37 P9](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c8 P68](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0068)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife and community volunteer  <sub>[v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c14 P5](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0005)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Cornelia  <sub>[v2 c6 P44](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0044)</sub>; Mrs. Marshall Elliott  <sub>[v4 c35 P0](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Cornelia Bryant is a plump, fresh-faced woman with a rosy complexion, jolly brown eyes, and smooth hair coifed or worn with a hard little knob under an old-fashioned sun-hat. Though not given to vanity in her attire, she wears a black dress for church and occasionally dons a calico wrapper with pink rose patterns, or a blue-and-white striped apron, even when making calls. She eventually chooses a navy blue silk dress for her wedding.

_Sources: [v2 c3 P0](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0000), [v2 c6 P0](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0000), [v2 c6 P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 c8 P20](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0020), [v4 c37 P26](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0026)_

## Personality

Outspoken, sharp-tongued, and fiercely opinionated, Cornelia is a staunch Presbyterian with a deep-seated scorn for men, Methodists, and foolishness. Beneath her sarcastic exterior lies an exceptionally kind, generous, and neighborly heart, making her the first to offer practical help to anyone in trouble. She is intensely loyal to her female friends and takes pride in her independence, household skills, and outspoken honesty. Though she insists she despises men, she possesses a keen sense of humor and takes a secret delight in managing them.

_Sources: [v2 c6 P41](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0041), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c9 P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c8 P27](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0027), [v4 c8 P57](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0057)_

## History

Cornelia Bryant lived for many years as an independent spinster in an emerald-green house at Four Winds. Having lost her mother at a young age, she raised her younger brother, whose early death left a lasting mark on her. She maintained a close, protective friendship with Leslie Moore, standing by her through years of hardship. When Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe moved to the house of dreams at Four Winds, Cornelia quickly bonded with Anne as a 'kindred spirit' of the race that knows Joseph. She actively engaged in church work, served as a leader in the Ladies' Aid Society, and frequently aided destitute families. Though she spent decades scoffing at men and marriage, she eventually agreed to marry her longtime suitor, Marshall Elliott, after he fulfilled his vow to cut his hair and beard upon a Liberal political victory. They married in an intimate ceremony, with Marshall moving into her house at Four Winds.

_Sources: [v4 c5 P6](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0006), [v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c7 P59](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0059), [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 c8 P75](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0075), [v4 c11 P30](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0030), [v4 c14 P5](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0005), [v4 c34 P31](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0031), [v4 c35 P30](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0030), [v4 c37 P9](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Four Winds as the daughter of Stephen Bryant  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v4 c8 P43](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0043)</sub>
- Raised her younger brother after their mother died when she was young  <sub>[v4 c34 P31](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0031)</sub>
- Was pursued by suitors in her youth, including Marshall Elliott and Amos Grant, but remained unmarried for many years  <sub>[v4 c8 P51](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0051), [v4 c37 P9](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0009), [v4 c37 P16](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0016)</sub>
